part.text: All 531 basics tests pass (9 skipped as feature-dependent). The fix is a one-line change in py/mpz.c:1720 — the comma is only appended when the number isn't fully consumed yet (`!done`), preventing the trailing comma on the most-significant group that appeared as a leading comma after the string reversal. The reproducer now prints `123,456,789,123,456,789,123,456,789` correctly.
